notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (Meridian Swell) evaluating Redwood as primary inference provider. Started with Hosted API POC (chat + embeddings) to validate quality and latency; now moving to Dedicated/VPC security review before procurement decision.

Background / context:
- 230 employees, core product: in-app analytics + contextual assistant for product managers. Heavy use of embeddings for search and changelog summarization.
- Initial hosted API POC launched 2026-01-20 (dev sandbox). Team: VP Eng (L. Morales), Head of ML (T. Becker), Infra lead (S. Huang).

Technical requirements / goals:
- Workloads: chat (feature-flagged in-product assistant), semantic search (embeddings), reranking for discovery pipelines.
- Latency targets: <200ms 95th for short chat turns (95% of reads), <100ms for embedding lookup round-trip (end-to-end).
- Throughput: steady-state 30-50 qps for embeddings queries; spiky chat traffic up to 120 concurrent sessions during launches.
- Model preferences: open-source models preferred (cost), want quantized variants for production. Need fallback routing to smaller model family for graceful degradation.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit economics improve by 30% vs hosted on-demand.

Security & compliance ask (key):
- SOC2 audit report required (Type II preferred) before Dedicated onboarding. VP Eng: "Can't take customer data to a new vendor without SOC2".
- Enterprise SSO (SAML) + SCIM for user provisioning in Console.
- Audit logging for inference requests and admin actions; retention control to configure 12 months or configurable windows.
- KMS integration for customer-managed keys (encrypt config/keys at rest).
- Data residency: primary US-only (support for region pinning).
- VPC requirements: private endpoints + VPC peering with GCP project, egress control list, DNS and certs.
